fixedPhases: Geographic teacher for resources, powering and forced/setup moves
objective: Actual terminal win credit, gamma=1 Monte Carlo returns, learned sigmoid baseline, weighted advantage normalization and equal total weight per game; no rewards from caps
selection: Greedy in-map macro-cell win credit; earliest tie wins; zero residual is eligible; reject selection candidates with any cap/error or >0.1 per-map regression. Confirmation/transfer after selection only. No final seeds.
storage: Only current rollout tensors in RAM; no trajectories on disk. Persist last/best optimizer checkpoints, immutable source pins, compact game outcomes and metrics on private HF. No production promotion.
